customize.title: Customize
customize.description: Theme style, mode and palette are only attributes on <html>: every component follows at once, the calling code stays the same.

hero.title: One component API.
hero.subtitle: Every design language.
hero.lead: `@skeinui/ui` leaves behaviour and accessibility to Base UI and the look to a swappable theme style. The same calling code becomes HeroUI, Ant Design or shadcn by changing one `data-skein-theme`.

lab.title: Same code, four looks.
lab.lead: Every card below renders the same JSX; only the `data-skein-theme` around it differs. Click Use to switch the whole site.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.body: Focus management, keyboard, aria and positioning come from Base UI. Component code has no styles and no `className` way in.

style.title: Theme style
style.body: A theme style is a set of CSS: selectors, structure, proportions. Switching it changes no calling code, and tests make sure every theme style covers every slot.

palette.title: Palette & mode
palette.body: A palette only changes token values (colours, radius, density), the mode switches light and dark. The three are independent and combine freely.

example.title: Whole apps, not just parts.
example.lead: Apps made with the admin template and existing components only, each in a repository of its own.

mail.title: Skein Mail
mail.desc: An email client: a menu of mailboxes, a message list and reader, compose with drafts and attachments, four theme styles.
mail.alt: Skein Mail: a list of messages beside the open message, in the HeroUI theme style

admin.title: Skein Admin
admin.desc: An admin dashboard: menu, tabs, tenants and permissions, searchable list pages, three sign-in looks, four theme styles.
admin.alt: Skein Admin: the Orders list with a search bar and table tools, in the HeroUI theme style
